text:
maya: Quick sync — starting a small solution-accelerator kit for Cloud Marketplace listings that bundles: Terraform modules, ARM templates, quickstart reference arch doc, and a lightweight e2e test harness. Goal: 1.0 by next sprint so partners can self-onboard. Thoughts?

chris: Love it. Should we make the infra modules multi-arch (x86 + arm64) out of the gate? Partners ask about Ampere/Graviton compatibility a lot.

maya: Yes — multi-arch is required. Plan: provide two TF module variants and a common params layer. We'll keep code paths shared where possible.

alex: For packaging, can we publish a single .zip with metadata.yaml + module/ + templates/? Marketplace teams prefer a single artifact. Also need publish script for marketplace ingestion.

sarah: Timeline — can we get MVP (docs + TF module + ARM template examples + CI) in 2 weeks? Need to coordinate with Partner Marketing for a joint blog after release.

kevin: I can own the Terraform module work. I'll start a repo skeleton and CI. pinging @chris for reference arch inputs.

chris: Awesome. For CI, let's include these checks:
```
- terraform fmt -check
- terraform init -backend=false
- terraform validate
- terraform plan -var-file=ci.tfvars
```
Also, add a quick cluster smoke test we can run in a small sandbox account.

alex: Packaging script suggestion (bash):
```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
ZIP=solution-accelerator-${VERSION}.zip
mkdir -p build
cp -r modules templates docs metadata.yaml build/
zip -r ${ZIP} build/
# push to internal artifact registry
```

maya: For metadata.yaml include: name, version, supported_arch: [x86_64, arm64], marketplace_templates: [azure, aws], test_matrix link.

deploy-bot: New PR opened: rwd/marketplace-accelerator#12 by kevin — initial TF module skeleton. CI: pending.

kevin: PR ready for reviews. cc @alex @chris. I'll add x86/arm example variables tomorrow.

sarah: Logistics: Need a release checklist itemizing: security review, partner legal signoff, marketplace listing assets, install scripts, sample app. Assign owners?

maya: Owners: kevin (TF modules), chris (reference arch + tests), alex (packaging + CI), sarah (release coordination). I'll track with a shared spreadsheet.

chris: One more: can we provide short perf notes around quantization / optimized kernels for Ampere vs Graviton? Partner SEs will ask. Maybe a small benchmark in the docs.

kevin: Yep — will add a 'notes/perf.md' with commands we ran and sample numbers.

alex: I'll stub the publish pipeline to push artifacts to our internal marketplace staging bucket: s3://rwd-marketplace-staging/solution-accelerator/

sarah: Marketing: holding off on blog until we have partner-approved screenshots and a simple getting-started video.

maya: Thanks all. Next sync in 3 days. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :rocket:

chris: :thumbsup:

kevin: Starting branch now, ETA for first review in ~18 hours.
